entries.subject: Shape
entries.finding: A sphere of the model radius (Nowak et al. 2020); no image of the planet exists. The gray is a display convention.

entries.subject: Orbit and mass
entries.finding: Lacour et al. (2021), A&A 654, L2, GRAVITY astrometry and HARPS radial velocities in the orbitize! conventions of Blunt et al. (2020).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: No limb darkening is drawn: the published limb table (Claret, Hauschildt & Witte 2012) starts at 1,500 K, and at 1,250 K the planet is below it. Its one published fit is an Exo-REM model (Nowak et al. 2020), which prints the temperature and gravity (1250 +/- 50 K, log g 3.85 +0.15/-0.25) but not the metallicity or C/O the model was read at, so the model of Exo-REM's public grid cannot be named.
